bugs.error_message: dsh failed to boot: SyntaxError: Unexpected token '\uFEFF' ... is not valid JSON at readProfileManifest (dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:754)
bugs.fix: PowerShell 5.1 `Set-Content -Encoding utf8` writes a UTF-8 BOM. Rewrite the JSON with [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(path, raw, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))) or use -Encoding utf8NoBOM on PowerShell 7+.
